title: Concept: NuGet accepts packages without a valid signature
description: nuget.config declares a `signatureValidationMode` of `accept`, which does not require a signed package, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: An unsigned or tampered package restores exactly like a signed one, so the signature chain never gates the build.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through nuget.config (nuget).
risk: An unsigned or tampered package restores exactly like a signed one, so the signature chain never gates the build.
